1) Entity: use "Redwood Inference Ltd" (UK EORI/EU servicing entity) on the proforma for NovaCorp’s EU contract.
2) VAT verification: I've pulled a VIES check (snapshot attached) — the VAT number appears to validate but we need the copy of the certificate you already supplied for our records.
3) Reverse‑charge wording to include on proforma: "VAT reverse‑charge applies. Customer to account for VAT under Article 194 of the VAT Directive. No VAT charged by supplier." Include NovaCorp VAT ID in the invoice header.
